recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white band photograph superimposed over a vibrant, horizontal rainbow gradient background. The image features four figures in retro-kitsch attire (polka dots, beehive hair, suits) performing with instruments and microphones, framed by a thin pink border and accented with hand-drawn neon typography and graphic icons.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black subjects against a saturated neon background
Horizontal color bands transitioning from magenta to yellow to cyan
Hand-drawn circular typography overlapping the lower right subject
Repeated tiki lantern motifs hanging along the top edge
coreInvariants: Heavy black shadows with minimal mid-tone detail in subjects
Doodle-style graphic elements including eyes and arrows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged horizontally across the frame, mid-shot from waist up, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black silhouettes of the band members against the bright background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the guitarist on the left, across the central performers, to the dense typographic cluster in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is relatively open, defined by the gradient and hanging lanterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Rainbow gradient (magenta, orange, yellow, green, cyan) acting as the primary environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black used for all photographic subjects and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink and yellow used for hand-drawn lettering and graphic doodles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the background vs. zero saturation (pure black) in the foreground subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Monolinear, hand-drawn sans-serif with irregular heights.
letterConstructionRules: Integrated graphic icons like eyes and arrows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters arranged in a circular path
Small 'the' tucked into the curve of larger letters
Eye icons replacing counters or floating near text

composition.overlap: Overlays the subject's legs and torso

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-drawn style with varying scales and colors (pink and yellow) to create internal hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the DIY, punk-adjacent aesthetic of the original lettering.
Captures the kitsch/retro energy of the band's style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a 1980s new wave band with a woman in a beehive and a man in a suit. Overlay this onto a vibrant horizontal rainbow gradient background (magenta to yellow to cyan). Add small tiki lanterns hanging from a wire at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, neon pink and yellow circular lettering in the bottom right corner. The text should follow a round path with small arrow and eye doodles integrated into the layout.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth horizontal rainbow gradient?
Are the band members rendered in high-contrast black with minimal detail?
Is there a thin pink border around the entire composition?
Is the text hand-drawn and arranged in a circular shape?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black subjects do not have color bleed from the background.
Verify the pink border is perfectly rectangular.
Check that the hand-drawn text is legible but maintains a 'doodle' quality.
Confirm the tiki lanterns are silhouette-style or high-contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast black subjects + horizontal rainbow gradient + circular hand-drawn neon typography + kitsch graphic accents.
